input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 meets the preferred position in full: audits are limited to once per twelve-month period, require thirty days' prior written notice, occur during normal business hours, are conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (§ 22.1), and Vendor bears the cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent (§ 22.2). Section 22.2 also expressly prohibits direct access to Customer systems, Customer Data unrelated to usage, privileged material and third-party confidential information, so the walk-away risk of unannounced audits or remote system access does not arise. Section 22.3 adds customer-favourable protections (findings are our Confidential Information, copy of the report, closure of the audited issue). No redline required; § 23 contains no separate records/assurance obligation to flag.
